name: shelter
processing: Center crop 2px top/bottom, silent H264 CRF17, no frame interpolation, no speed change, no upscale
cost: local GPU only; no paid API

review.method: All 31 decoded chronological samples at 6fps plus full decode; no audio in asset
review.observations: Two grounded filament roots rise gradually and meet into one shelter arch by roughly 2.7s; arch thickens gently to final frame. Large center remains dark and readable. Sampled frames show no cuts, duplicating shapes, abrupt flash or unwanted letters. Frame edges stay clear except a low line at bases near margins.
review.limitations: Sparse frames do not certify every frame or full-speed smoothness. Final composite still requires encoded review; generated video must have active coded foreground even in instrumental opening.
review.recommendedComposite: Screen or luma blend with soft outer edge mask, matched amber/ivory foreground contours and contemporary photo beneath central dark negative space; keep title/lyrics away from bright arch crest.
